seoTitle: Forsyth County Schools Calendar 2025–26: Key Dates and PDF
seoDescription: See Forsyth County Schools' 2025–26 student calendar, including first and last days, major breaks, online learning dates, early-release dates, and the official PDF.
heroSummary: Forsyth County schedules K–12 Online Learning and Parent Conference Days in October and March. High schools use exam early releases at each semester end, while October 20, January 5, and February 17 are student-free Professional Development Days.
calendarNotes: The official Forsyth County Schools 2025–26 student calendar lists districtwide breaks, professional development student holidays, K–12 online learning and parent conference days, and early-release dates. Students do not attend on October 20, January 5, and February 17 because those dates are professional development days. October 17 and March 13 are listed as K–12 online learning and parent conference dates.
heroFactChips: K–12 early-release days: Aug. 29, Feb. 13, and May 22
Online learning and parent conferences: Oct. 17 and Mar. 13
keyDatesSummarySubtitle: First and last days of school, plus the district's major break dates
allDatesCoverageNote: This list includes districtwide dates that affect students. It does not include teacher preplanning or post-planning, open houses, or staff-only dates outside the student school year.

icsDescription: Download the 2025–26 dates for Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, or Outlook.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Forsyth County Schools start in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Forsyth County Schools starts the 2025–26 school year on Tuesday, August 5, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Forsyth County Schools Fall Break in 2025?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, September 22, through Friday, September 26, 2025.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Forsyth County Schools Spring Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, April 6, through Friday, April 10, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: Do students attend school in person on FCS Online Learning days?
calendarFaqs.a: No. On October 17, 2025, and March 13, 2026, students follow the district's online learning and parent conference schedule rather than a normal in-person school day.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I find the official Forsyth County Schools calendar?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official Forsyth County Schools calendar page and the district's official 2025–26 student calendar PDF for final confirmation.

customSections.label: What Forsyth Families Need to Know
customSections.content: Several dates change the normal school-day schedule and may affect child care, transportation, or after-school plans.

groups.label: Early release and online learning
items: K–12 early-release days are August 29, February 13, and May 22. High school exam early-release days are December 17–18 and May 20–21.
Students learn online Friday, October 17, and Friday, March 13, on the district's online learning and parent conference schedule.

groups.label: Professional development student holidays
items: Students do not attend on October 20, January 5, or February 17 because those dates are professional development days.

groups.label: School-specific details
items: The district calendar covers systemwide student dates. Confirm campus events, testing, athletics, transportation, and exact early-release times with FCS or your assigned school.
